releases.name: Coarena 0.1.1
releases.body:
Coarena now publishes stable npm releases through GitHub Actions Trusted Publishing (OIDC), with provenance and no long-lived npm token.

- Stable GitHub Releases validate the source SHA, tag/package/lockfile versions, and package contents before publishing that same commit.
- Manual workflow runs validate and dry-run only; the publish job uses the `npm` environment restricted to `v*` tags.
- Added release boundary tests and public tarball/provenance metadata checks. Provider, model and quota behavior is unchanged.

Validation: 77 offline tests, Node Request/entry checks, actual 12-file package checks, actionlint, Node 22/24 CI and the manual publishing dry-run passed. npm delivery is performed by the release-triggered **Publish npm** workflow. Real Coarena inference and host end-to-end testing remain unverified.

Workflow and maintainer instructions: https://github.com/Mars-Sea/coarena/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md

releases.name: Coarena 0.1.0
releases.body:
Initial Coarena provider plugin for Magpie and OpenCode.

- API key authentication using host credential storage.
- Public dynamic model discovery, Chat Completions, tool and image capability mapping.
- Daily quota cards in Magpie, with Simplified Chinese by default and an English option.
- Official embedded SVG for plugin and provider icons.
- Separate main and OpenCode 2 entries, ESM, no production dependencies.

Install in Magpie:

```sh
magpie plugin add coarena
magpie plugin login coarena
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/coarena/v/0.1.0

Validation: 68 offline tests; Node 22 / 24 CI; public npm tarball hash, 12-file contents and isolated imports verified. Real Coarena inference and host end-to-end acceptance remain unverified. See docs/VALIDATION.md for the complete evidence and scope.

Coarena retains prompts and responses even with store:false. Its logo and API metadata retain their original rights.
